# ILLUSORR

> ILLUSORR (also written ILLUSORR Labs) is a creative technology studio in Abu Dhabi, UAE. It makes content and film, immersive spaces, games and original IP across physical, digital and virtual worlds, for brands, houses and institutions.

Contact: hello@illusorr.com. Based at Yas Creative Hub, Abu Dhabi.

## Sectors
- Culture & Immersive: installations and immersive experiences for cultural moments. https://illusorr.com/sectors/culture
- Gaming, Worlds & IP: worlds, digital twins and licensable IP for studios and platforms. https://illusorr.com/sectors/gaming
- Beauty & Fragrance: campaign grade content and product worlds. https://illusorr.com/sectors/beauty
- Fashion, Retail & Jewellery: editorial and campaign production. https://illusorr.com/sectors/fashion
- Real Estate & Architecture: visualisation and launch material. https://illusorr.com/sectors/real-estate
- Business & Institutions: brand, web and product. https://illusorr.com/sectors/business
